home.title: Dashboard
home.description: Overview of your personal account's activity across all your projects.

home.title: Get started
home.description: Three steps from a new organization to a first API call.

credits.title: Add credits
credits.description: Requests are paid from a prepaid balance. Nothing is charged until you add one.

key.title: Create an API key
key.description: One key per app or teammate. A key can carry its own spending limit.

call.title: Call a model
call.description: Use the key with any model in the catalog, in the OpenAI request format.

dataPolicy.title: Decide where your data may go
dataPolicy.description: By default any provider may serve your requests. Set the regions, the retention limit and whether training is allowed.
